const mf=n=>440*Math.pow(2,(n-69)/12),dg=(r,sc,d)=>{const n=sc.length;return r+sc[((d%n)+n)%n]+12*Math.floor(d/n)},hx=c=>c==="-"?99:parseInt(c,16);

[[46,"H",1,1],[45,"m",3,3],[52,"F",3,2],[48,"H",1,5],[47,"F",4,4],[43,"H",1,3],[45,"F",3,0],[50,"m",1,1],[54,"H",3,5],[42,"F",4,2],[55,"m",1,4],[44,"H",3,3],[47,"m",4,1],[40,"H",1,4]].forEach((a,i)=>{TD["boss"+i]=[a[0],a[1],168+i*2,"sawtooth",a[2],a[3],1]});
const TRK={};Object.keys(TD).forEach(k=>{const a=TD[k];TRK[k]={r:a[0],s:SC[a[1]],bpm:a[2],w:a[3],pr:a[4],ar:a[5],hv:a[6]}});

let tStep=0,tName="";
function jingle(win){const seq=win?[72,76,79,84,79,84,88]:[64,62,60,55],ty=win?"triangle":"sawtooth",gap=win?150:300;seq.forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>sfx(mf(n),gap/1000*1.6,ty,.05),i*gap))}
function musicTick(){const nm=!musicOn?"":S==="play"?(lvl===99?"tut":(boss.active&&!boss.dead)?"boss"+boss.k:"L"+lvl):(S==="win"||S==="over")?"":"menu";
 if(nm!==tName){if(nm===""&&musicOn&&(S==="win"||S==="over"))jingle(S==="win");tName=nm;tStep=0}
 let dl=200;const ok=AC&&AC.state==="running";
 if(nm&&TRK[nm]){const K=TRK[nm];dl=15000/K.bpm;if(ok){const sec=dl/1000,bar=(tStep>>4)&3,s=tStep&15,cd=PRG[K.pr][bar],ro=dg(K.r,K.s,cd),hv=K.hv;
  if(s%4===0)sfx(155,.15,"sine",.14,-115);
  if(s===4||s===12||(bar===3&&s>=13))sfx(300,.09,"square",.04,-200);
  if(s%2===0)sfx(9000,.025,"square",.011);if(s%4===2)sfx(7000,.07,"square",.008);
  if(hv){sfx(mf(ro-24+(s%8===6?12:0)),sec*.95,"sawtooth",.04)}else if(s%2===0){sfx(mf(ro-24+(s%4===2?7:0)),sec*1.9,"triangle",.07)}
  if(s%8!==7)sfx(mf(dg(K.r+12,K.s,cd+ARP[K.ar][s&7]+(bar&1?2:0))),sec*1.3,K.w,.024);
  if(bar>=2&&(s===0||s===3||s===6||s===8||s===10||s===12))sfx(mf(dg(K.r+24,K.s,cd+[0,2,4,2,5,4,7][(s+bar)%7])),sec*2.2,"square",.016)}
  tStep++}
 setTimeout(musicTick,dl)}

function runEnd(){if(!inRun)return;inRun=false;plays++;if(plays>=5){plays=0;Object.keys(ups).forEach(k=>ups[k]=0);noticeTxt="¡Pasaron 5 partidas! Tus mejoras de la tienda desaparecieron. Tus monedas se quedan.";noticeUntil=performance.now()+9000}save()}
function newGame(n){inRun=n!==99;lvl=n;lap=0;score=0;coinsN=0;lives=DIFS[dif].lv+ups.lf;startLevel()}
function nextLap(){const o=p;lap++;score+=500*lap;gc(5*lap);build();const n=p;n.hp=Math.min(HPM(),o.hp+1);n.inv=1.5;n.sh=Math.max(o.sh,3);n.dj=o.dj;n.bg=o.bg;n.spd=o.spd;n.vx=o.vx*.5;n.f=o.f;pop(n.x+60,n.y-40,"¡VUELTA "+(lap+1)+"!");sfx(880,.12,"square",.06,500);sfx(1320,.2,"square",.06)}
function startLevel(){build();S="play";time=0;sfx(660,.15,"square",.06,400)}
function toMenu(){S="menu";shake=0;runEnd();save()}

addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.target&&e.target.tagName==="INPUT")return;if(KM[e.key]){inp[KM[e.key]]=true;e.preventDefault()}else if(JK.includes(e.key)){if(!inp.j)inp.jp=true;inp.j=true;e.preventDefault()}
 else if(e.key==="Enter"){if(S==="menu")act.play();else if(S==="over")act.retry();else if(S==="win"&&lvl<13)act.next()}
 else if(e.key==="Escape"&&S!=="menu")toMenu();else if(e.key==="m"||e.key==="M"){musicOn=!musicOn;$("mu").textContent=musicOn?"🎵":"🔇"}});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{if(e.target&&e.target.tagName==="INPUT")return;if(KM[e.key])inp[KM[e.key]]=false;else if(JK.includes(e.key))inp.j=false});
const bind=(id,k)=>{const b=$(id);const on=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.classList.add("on");if(k==="j"&&!inp.j)inp.jp=true;inp[k]=true},off=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.classList.remove("on");inp[k]=false};b.addEventListener("pointerdown",on);["pointerup","pointerleave","pointercancel"].forEach(n=>b.addEventListener(n,off))};
bind("bl","l");bind("br","r");bind("ba","at");bind("bj","j");
const setMs=e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();ms.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width;ms.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*H/r.height;ms.t=performance.now();ms.pt=e.pointerType||"mouse"};
cv.addEventListener("pointermove",setMs);
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{setMs(e);if(S==="play"){if(e.button===0||e.pointerType!=="mouse"){inp.ck=true;inp.mb=true}}else{for(const b of btns)if(!b.dis&&ms.x>=b.x&&ms.x<=b.x+b.w&&ms.y>=b.y&&ms.y<=b.y+b.h){sfx(700,.08,"square",.05,300);b.fn();break}}});
addEventListener("pointerup",()=>{inp.mb=false});cv.addEventListener("contextmenu",e=>e.preventDefault());

const add=(n,x,y)=>{score+=n;if(x!=null)pop(x,y,"+"+n)};

function die(){if(lvl!==99&&!(ups.rv&&!rvUsed))lives--;else if(lvl!==99){rvUsed=true;pop(p.x,p.y-30,"¡SEGUNDA OPORTUNIDAD!")}sfx(300,.6,"square",.07,-250);if(lives<=0){S="over";save();endRun();runEnd();return}
 p.x=cp;p.y=12*T-56;p.vx=p.vy=0;p.hp=HPM();p.inv=1.5;p.sh=p.dj=p.bg=p.spd=0;
 if(boss.active&&!boss.dead){resetBoss();balls=[];enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.x<AR*T);for(let r=3;r<12;r++)G[r][AR]=0;gateOpen=true}}
function spawnItem(c,r){if(lvl!==99&&Math.random()>.6-.1*HD())return;let k=[0,0,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,4][Math.floor(Math.random()*10)];if(k===0&&p.hp>=HPM())k=2;items.push({x:c*T+5,y:r*T-24,w:22,h:22,vx:0,vy:-260,k,ground:false});sfx(660,.15,"triangle",.07,500)}

 else if(t===2){G[r][c]=0;add(50,c*T+8,r*T);sfx(150,.15,"square",.06,-60);burst(c*T+16,r*T+16,th.br,10)}}
const plantBox=pl=>{const q=((time+pl.ph)%3.4)/3.4,near=Math.abs(p.x+p.w/2-pl.x)<46;let f=q<.15?q/.15:q<.55?1:q<.7?(.7-q)/.15:0;if(near)f=0;pl.f=f;return{x:pl.x-14,y:pl.top-f*40,w:28,h:f*40}};

const BCFG={
 6:{m:"walk",sp:62,cs:360,jp:560,jn:3.4,jf:2.4,r:2.7,fr:1.8,a:["aim","rain","spike","charge","aim"],sk:0,c:"#f59e0b"},
 7:{m:"walk",sp:88,cs:470,jp:640,jn:2.6,jf:1.8,r:2.2,fr:1.5,a:["lob","wave","laser","aim","charge"],sk:1,c:"#22d3ee"},

function bAtk(b,id,fury,DM,CF){
 const cx=b.x+b.w/2,cy=b.y+b.h/2,c=CF.c,S1=Math.min(DM,2),nE=enemies.filter(e=>!e.gone&&e.dead<=0&&e.x>AR*T).length;
 if(id==="charge"&&CF.m!=="walk")id="aim";
 if(id==="summon"&&nE>=3)id="aim";
 if(id==="aim"){const a=Math.atan2(p.y+p.h/2-cy,p.x-cx),n=fury?5:3;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const an=a+(i-(n-1)/2)*.28;balls.push({x:cx,y:cy,vx:Math.cos(an)*230*S1,vy:Math.sin(an)*230*S1,k:"o",c,w:16,h:16,l:0})}sfx(300,.3,"sawtooth",.06,-150)}
 else if(id==="lob"){const n=fury?4:3;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)balls.push({x:cx,y:b.y+20,vx:b.f*(120+i*80),vy:-430-i*45,g:1,k:"p",c,w:16,h:16,l:0});sfx(260,.3,"square",.06,-100)}
 else if(id==="rain"){rainF(fury?9:6,c,"f");pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡LLUVIA!")}
 else if(id==="spike"){(fury?[-150,-75,0,75,150]:[-80,0,80]).forEach(d=>balls.push({k:"s",x:clamp(p.x+p.w/2+d,(AR+2)*T,(COLS-4)*T),y:0,vx:0,vy:0,warn:.8,life:.7,l:0}));pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡PINCHOS!");sfx(200,.3,"square",.06,200)}
 else if(id==="wave"){[-1,1].forEach(s=>balls.push({x:cx,y:12*T-12,vx:s*230*S1,vy:0,w:44,h:24,k:"w",c,l:0}));shake=.3;sfx(80,.4,"sawtooth",.1,-30);pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡ONDA!")}
 else if(id==="laser"){balls.push({k:"z",x:0,y:Math.random()<.5?12*T-30:12*T-108,vx:0,vy:0,warn:.9,life:.5,l:0});pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡LÁSER!");sfx(900,.9,"sawtooth",.05,-500)}
 else if(id==="nova"){const n=fury?14:9;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=i/n*Math.PI*2+.2;balls.push({x:cx,y:cy,vx:Math.cos(a)*170,vy:Math.sin(a)*170,k:"f",c,w:16,h:16,l:0})}pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡NOVA!");sfx(180,.4,"sawtooth",.08,-100)}
 else if(id==="summon"){for(let i=0;i<2;i++)mkE(clamp(Math.floor(b.x/T)+(i?-5:5),AR+2,COLS-6),CF.sk,90+i);pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡REFUERZOS!");sfx(180,.4,"sawtooth",.07,200)}
 else if(id==="charge"){b.rl=1.5;b.df=b.f;pop(cx,b.y-14,"¡EMBESTIDA!");sfx(150,.5,"sawtooth",.08,200)}}
function bossNew(b,dt,fury,DM){
 const CF=BCFG[b.k],DB=Math.min(DM,2.1),minX=(AR+2)*T,maxX=(COLS-3)*T-b.w,wv=s=>balls.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:12*T-12,vx:s*215*DB,vy:0,w:44,h:24,k:"w",c:CF.c,l:0});let vul=true;
 b.ft-=dt;b.jt-=dt;b.sT-=dt;
 const rate=()=>(fury?CF.fr:CF.r)/DB,atk=()=>{b.ft=rate();bAtk(b,CF.a[Math.floor(Math.random()*CF.a.length)],fury,DM,CF);if(CF.dbl&&fury&&Math.random()<.5)bAtk(b,CF.a[Math.floor(Math.random()*CF.a.length)],fury,DM,CF)};
 if(CF.sh){if(b.shT>0){b.shT-=dt;vul=false}else{b.ca-=dt;if(b.ca<=0){b.ca=CF.sh;b.shT=2.6;pop(b.x,b.y-26,"¡ESCUDO!");sfx(600,.4,"sine",.06,300);if(!enemies.some(e=>!e.gone&&e.dead<=0&&e.x>AR*T))for(let i=0;i<2;i++)mkE(clamp(Math.floor(b.x/T)+(i?-5:5),AR+2,COLS-6),CF.sk,95+i)}}}
 if(CF.m==="walk"){
  if(b.rl>0){b.rl-=dt;b.vx=b.rl>.9?0:b.df*(fury?CF.cs*1.2:CF.cs)*DB;move(b,dt)}
  else{
   if(b.st===0){b.vx=b.hurt>0?0:b.f*(fury?CF.sp*1.5:CF.sp)*DB;if(b.jt<=0&&b.ground){b.vy=-CF.jp;b.st=1;b.ground=false;b.jt=(fury?CF.jf:CF.jn)/DB}}else b.vx=b.f*CF.sp*1.4*DB;
   if(b.ft<=0)atk();
   move(b,dt);
   if(b.st===1&&b.ground){b.st=0;shake=.35;sfx(80,.4,"sawtooth",.1,-30);wv(-1);wv(1)}}}
 else if(CF.m==="fly"){
  if(b.st===0){const tx=clamp(p.x-b.w/2+Math.sin(time*1.3)*140,minX,maxX);b.x+=clamp((tx-b.x)*1.5,-150*DB,150*DB)*dt;b.y+=(140+Math.sin(time*2)*20-b.y)*3*dt;
   if(b.ft<=0)atk();
   if(b.sT<=0){if(Math.random()<.5){b.st=1;b.sT=.6;b.tx=p.x-b.w/2;pop(b.x,b.y-20,"¡PICADA!")}else b.sT=(fury?1.6:2.4)/DB}}
  else if(b.st===1){if(b.sT<=0){b.st=2;b.tx=clamp(b.tx,minX,maxX);b.sT=2;sfx(200,.4,"sawtooth",.08,300)}}
  else if(b.st===2){const gy=12*T-b.h-6,dx=b.tx-b.x,dy=gy-b.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,sp=(fury?540:440)*DB;b.x+=dx/d*Math.min(sp*dt,d);b.y+=dy/d*Math.min(sp*dt,d);if(d<8||b.sT<=0){b.st=3;b.sT=.7;shake=.3;wv(-1);wv(1)}}
  else if(b.st===3){if(b.sT<=0)b.st=4}
  else{b.y-=200*dt;if(b.y<=140){b.y=140;b.st=0;b.sT=(fury?1.8:2.8)/DB}}
  b.x=clamp(b.x,minX,maxX)}
 else if(CF.m==="still"){
  b.vx=0;
  if(b.st===0){if(b.ft<=0)atk();if(b.sT<=0){b.st=1;b.sT=2.6;pop(b.x,b.y-14,"¡SE SUMERGE!");sfx(120,.5,"sine",.07,-60)}}
  else{vul=false;if(b.ft<=0){b.ft=rate()*.7;bAtk(b,Math.random()<.5?"spike":"wave",fury,DM,CF)}if(b.sT<=0){b.st=0;b.sT=5.5;pop(b.x,b.y-14,"¡EMERGE!")}}
  move(b,dt)}
 else{
  if(b.tps===0){b.vx=b.hurt>0?0:b.f*(fury?90:60)*DB;b.tj-=dt;
   if(b.tj<=0){b.tps=1;b.tpt=.35;b.tj=(fury?CF.tj*.7:CF.tj)/DB;sfx(500,.3,"sine",.06,-300)}
   if(b.ft<=0)atk()}
  else{b.vx=0;b.tpt-=dt;if(b.tpt<=0){if(b.tps===1){b.x=clamp(p.x+(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(170+Math.random()*90),minX,maxX);b.tps=2;b.tpt=.35;sfx(300,.3,"sine",.06,400);if(fury)bAtk(b,"nova",fury,DM,CF)}else b.tps=0}}
  move(b,dt);vul=b.tps===0}
 return vul}

function danceFX(P,t,id){
 if(id===13){const seq=[1,2,5,6];id=seq[Math.floor(t/2.4)%4];t=t%2.4}
 const S=Math.sin,C=Math.cos,PI=Math.PI,G=P.G,B=P.bodyG,H=P.headG,aL=P.aL,aR=P.aR,lL=P.lL,lR=P.lR;
 G.rotation.set(0,0,0);G.position.x=0;G.position.z=0;B.rotation.set(0,0,0);
 if(id===0)return;
 if(id===1){G.rotation.y=t*7;G.position.y=Math.abs(S(t*5))*.5}

// ---- efectos de ambiente por nivel
function fxDraw(k,cx,t){
 if(k==="grid"){g.save();g.strokeStyle="#ff2e9744";g.lineWidth=1.5;for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const y=250+i*i*3.2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,y);g.lineTo(W,y);g.stroke()}for(let i=-8;i<=8;i++){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(W/2+i*20,250);g.lineTo(W/2+i*130-((cx*.2)%130),H);g.stroke()}g.restore()}
 else if(k==="lightning"){const q=t%6;if(q<.5){g.save();g.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+(1-q/.5)+")";g.lineWidth=3;g.beginPath();let x=((Math.floor(t/6)*211)%700)+50,y=0;g.moveTo(x,y);while(y<260){y+=34;x+=(((y*7+Math.floor(t/6)*13)%40)-20);g.lineTo(x,y)}g.stroke();g.restore()}}}
function fxFront(k,cx,t){
 g.save();
 if(k==="lightning"){const q=t%6;if(q<.12){g.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,"+(.45*(1-q/.12))+")";g.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}g.restore();return}

const SWD={cl:{w:4,o:"#111",b:"#e6f4ff",e:"#67e8f9"},hi:{w:4,o:"#0c4a6e",b:"#bae6fd",e:"#fff",glow:"#38bdf8"},fi:{w:5,o:"#7c2d12",b:"#fb923c",e:"#fde047",glow:"#f97316"},ka:{w:2.6,o:"#111",b:"#f1f5f9",e:"#94a3b8"},or:{w:5,o:"#78350f",b:"#fde047",e:"#fffbeb",glow:"#fbbf24"},lv:{w:4,o:"#14532d",b:"#4ade80",e:"#fff",glow:"#22c55e",core:1},lr:{w:4,o:"#7f1d1d",b:"#f87171",e:"#fff",glow:"#ef4444",core:1},mg:{w:4,o:"#4c1d95",b:"#c084fc",e:"#f5d0fe",glow:"#a855f7"},dr:{w:5,o:"#000",b:"#7f1d1d",e:"#f97316",glow:"#ef4444",teeth:1},ar:{w:5,o:"#111",b:"",e:"#fff",glow:"#ffffff"}};
function swordArt(id,s0,s1,px,py){if(id==="no")return;const C=SWD[id]||SWD.cl,t=time;g.save();g.lineCap="round";if(C.glow){g.shadowColor=C.glow;g.shadowBlur=10}
 const col=id==="ar"?"hsl("+((t*200)%360|0)+",95%,60%)":C.b,L=(a,b,w,c)=>{g.lineWidth=w;g.strokeStyle=c;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);g.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);g.stroke()};
 L(s0,s1,C.w+3,C.o);L(s0,s1,C.w,col);
 if(C.core)L(s0,s1,C.w*.4,"#fff");else L([s0[0]+px*C.w*.2,s0[1]+py*C.w*.2],[s1[0]+px*C.w*.2,s1[1]+py*C.w*.2],1.3,C.e);
 if(C.teeth){g.fillStyle=C.e;for(let i=1;i<=5;i++){const a=i/6,bx=s0[0]+(s1[0]-s0[0])*a,by=s0[1]+(s1[1]-s0[1])*a;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(bx-px*2,by-py*2);g.lineTo(bx+px*7,by+py*7);g.lineTo(bx+(s1[0]-s0[0])*.07-px*2,by+(s1[1]-s0[1])*.07-py*2);g.fill()}}
 if(id==="fi"){for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=(i+((t*5)%1))/4,bx=s0[0]+(s1[0]-s0[0])*a,by=s0[1]+(s1[1]-s0[1])*a-Math.sin(t*20+i)*2;g.fillStyle=i%2?"#fde047":"#f97316";g.beginPath();g.arc(bx+px*3,by+py*3-3*(1-a),2.2*(1-a)+1,0,7);g.fill()}}
 if(id==="hi"||id==="mg"){g.fillStyle="#fff";for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=((t*.8+i/3)%1),bx=s0[0]+(s1[0]-s0[0])*a,by=s0[1]+(s1[1]-s0[1])*a;g.globalAlpha=1-a;g.fillRect(bx+px*5-1,by+py*5-1,2.4,2.4)}g.globalAlpha=1}
 g.restore()}

function drawPlayer(){if(p.inv>0&&Math.floor(p.inv*14)%2)return;
 const k=clamp(Math.abs(p.vx)/RUN,0,1),air=!p.ground,q=p.atk>0?1-p.atk/.34:-1,ph=p.ph,bob=air?0:(k>.1?Math.abs(Math.sin(ph))*2.6:Math.sin(time*3)*.7),cx=p.x+p.w/2-cam,fy=p.y+p.h+1;
 const lean=k*4+(air?(p.vy<0?-1.5:2):0),hip=[0,-21-bob],sh=[lean,-38-bob],hd=[lean+2,-48-bob],L=10.5,sqx=1+p.sq*.5,sqy=1-p.sq*.5;
 const line=(a,b,c)=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);g.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);if(c)g.lineTo(c[0],c[1]);g.stroke()};
 const SK=skinNow(),EQ={back:eqId("back"),body:eqId("body"),hat:eqId("hat"),face:eqId("face"),sword:eqId("sword")};g.save();g.globalAlpha*=SK.alpha;if(SK.glow){g.shadowColor=SK.glow;g.shadowBlur=9}g.translate(cx,fy);g.scale(p.f*sqx,sqy);g.lineCap="round";g.lineJoin="round";g.strokeStyle=SK.col;g.lineWidth=4.6;
 const leg=i=>{const f=ph+i*Math.PI;let a1,a2;if(air){a1=i?-.55:.6;a2=a1-(i?.5:.9)+(p.vy>0?.5:0)}else{a1=Math.sin(f)*.9*k;a2=a1-Math.max(0,Math.sin(f+.9))*1.15*k-.08*(1-k)}
  const kn=[hip[0]+Math.sin(a1)*L,hip[1]+Math.cos(a1)*L],ft=[kn[0]+Math.sin(a2)*L,kn[1]+Math.cos(a2)*L];line(hip,kn,ft);line(ft,[ft[0]+5,ft[1]])};
 const arm=b=>{const e=[sh[0]+Math.sin(b)*10,sh[1]+Math.cos(b)*10],h=[e[0]+Math.sin(b+.6)*10,e[1]+Math.cos(b+.6)*10];line(sh,e,h)};
 COSF.back(EQ.back,hip,sh,hd,k);leg(1);arm(air?-1:-Math.sin(ph)*.9*k+.15);line(hip,sh);leg(0);COSF.body(EQ.body,hip,sh,hd,k);
 if(ups.sc){g.strokeStyle="#e11d48";g.lineWidth=5;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(sh[0]+2,sh[1]+3);for(let i=1;i<=6;i++)g.lineTo(sh[0]-i*4-k*5,sh[1]+3+Math.sin(time*10+i)*(2+k*3)*(i/6)+i*.6);g.stroke();g.strokeStyle=SK.col;g.lineWidth=4.6}g.fillStyle=SK.hd;g.beginPath();g.arc(hd[0],hd[1],9.5,0,7);g.fill();g.stroke();COSF.head(EQ.hat,EQ.face,hip,sh,hd,k);g.restore();
 // brazo y espada en coordenadas del mundo: apuntan libremente
 const shx=cx+p.f*sh[0]*sqx,shy=fy+sh[1]*sqy,a=q>=0?swingA(p.th,q):p.as+Math.sin(ph*2)*.08*k,dx=Math.cos(a),dy=Math.sin(a),px=-dy,py=dx,hand=[shx+dx*13,shy+dy*13],K=(p.bg>0?1.7:1)*(1+.15*ups.sw);
 g.save();g.globalAlpha*=SK.alpha;g.lineCap="round";g.lineJoin="round";g.strokeStyle=SK.col;g.lineWidth=4.6;line([shx,shy],hand);
 if(q>=0){const a0=swingA(p.th,0),cc=Math.cos(p.th)<0;g.strokeStyle="rgba("+(ups.fl?"255,140,30":"255,255,255")+","+(1-q)*.9+")";g.lineWidth=6;g.beginPath();g.arc(shx,shy,54*K,a0,a,cc);g.stroke();g.strokeStyle="rgba("+(ups.fl?"255,230,80":"120,220,255")+","+(1-q)*.7+")";g.lineWidth=3;g.beginPath();g.arc(shx,shy,60*K,a0,a,cc);g.stroke()}
 g.lineWidth=5;g.strokeStyle="#444";line([hand[0]-dx*5,hand[1]-dy*5],[hand[0]+dx*5,hand[1]+dy*5]);
 g.lineWidth=3.2;g.strokeStyle="#d4a017";line([hand[0]+dx*6+px*6,hand[1]+dy*6+py*6],[hand[0]+dx*6-px*6,hand[1]+dy*6-py*6]);
 const s0=[hand[0]+dx*7,hand[1]+dy*7],s1=[hand[0]+dx*46*K,hand[1]+dy*46*K];swordArt(EQ.sword,s0,s1,px,py);g.restore()}
function drawItem(it){const x=it.x-cam+11,y=it.y+11+Math.sin(time*5+it.x)*2,c=ITC[it.k];g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.fillStyle=c+"44";g.beginPath();g.arc(0,0,17,0,7);g.fill();g.fillStyle="#1e1b4b";g.beginPath();g.arc(0,0,12,0,7);g.fill();g.strokeStyle=c;g.lineWidth=2;g.stroke();g.fillStyle=c;g.lineWidth=3;g.lineCap="round";
 if(it.k===0)heart(0,2,true);else if(it.k===1){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-6,-6);g.lineTo(6,-6);g.lineTo(6,1);g.quadraticCurveTo(6,7,0,9);g.quadraticCurveTo(-6,7,-6,1);g.closePath();g.fill()}
 else if(it.k===2){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-6,0);g.lineTo(0,-6);g.lineTo(6,0);g.moveTo(-6,6);g.lineTo(0,0);g.lineTo(6,6);g.stroke()}

build();S="menu";let last=performance.now(),acc=0;
function loop(n){acc+=Math.min(.1,(n-last)/1000);last=n;while(acc>=1/60){update(1/60);acc-=1/60}draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
